title: game
description: games/<slug>/game.json — the envelope of CONTRACTS §10, which the plan gives as one line and this file spells out. It holds no rules of its own beyond the two below: the five parts are $refs, so there is exactly one place each of them is described and this file cannot drift from it. build-game.js writes it; the Press Table reads it back when a page is re-opened for editing.

version.description: CONTRACTS §10 says version 1 and nothing has bumped it. `const` rather than a minimum because a reader that meets a 2 has met a file written by a newer builder and should stop rather than guess which half it still understands.

builtAt.description: The shape `new Date().toISOString()` writes, which is what stamps it — the pattern is that method's output read off, not a general ISO-8601 grammar (no offsets, no bare dates), so anything else in this field was written by hand and is probably a mistake.
